item.title: Permission Modes
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Six permission modes decide what runs without asking. The evaluation order they sit inside, what each one actually approves, how auto mode's classifier makes its call, and the paths no mode will ever wave through.
